trend_methods.cf: Christiano-Fitzgerald band-pass: series minus its 6-32 quarter (18-96 month) component
trend_methods.applied_to: 100 x log level for level series (shown in levels); the rate itself for rates; the value itself for the change in inventories

notes.nominal: Current-dollar component / current-dollar GDP. Shares add up to 100.
notes.real: Chained 2017-dollar component / chained 2017-dollar GDP. Chained components are not additive, so these ratios do not sum to 100, and they are most reliable near 2017.
notes.growth: Annualised quarter-on-quarter growth, 400 x [ln(X_t) - ln(X_t-1)], in percent; period columns are averages of quarterly growth rates.
